parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of deleting index_together when unique_together exists on the same fields, but it introduces a non-minimal change and may have unintended side effects.

issues.description: The patch introduces a non-minimal change by adding conditional logic to filter constraint names based on the type of constraint being deleted. This may have unintended side effects and could lead to maintenance issues.
The patch does not include any new tests to verify that the change works as expected in different scenarios. This increases the risk of introducing regressions in the future.
